label: 5. Watson, have you heard, of any incidents,,?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Watson, have you heard, of any incidents,,?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Peace is, everywhere throughout the, Arkk,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: These are trying, times for a, dettective,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I can feel my, sleuthing skills, deteriorating as, we speak,,,
At least you've still got enough brain cells to speak.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Very humorous,,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Anyway, I need something, to focus my, skills on,,
Isn't sniffing out cases one of the conditions of being a detective?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I've been, waiting for ages,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: but, nothing has, come my way,,
You can go out and look for them.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: So I, should be, a gumshoe,,?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I've tried, that already,
How'd it go?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I tromped around, the Ark all, day,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: but all I encountered, were cases about missing, items, misplaced this, forgotten, that, etc,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Not a, single homicide or, burglary case to, be found,,,!!

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Nothing for, a great detective like, myself to really sink, her teeth into,,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Is there anything, I could help, you with , maybe??
Loads.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: How low, will I sink,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Stilll,,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: it's better, than just loafing, around, I suppose,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: And helping you, is always a worthwhile, venture,,,
Make your way to the Commander's Room.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: ,,Will do,,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Be there in a minute,,,
